svg.title: Bounded native task flow
svg.desc: Conceptual source architecture, not live telemetry. One interactive and two non-UI workers share serialized resources. Browser and Skills are independent leased producers, not coordinator rows. Future unified rows and pending phone qualification are dashed.
svg.text: Bounded multitasking · native authority, not parallel LLMs
0.6.0-alpha-v3 source concept · host gates passed · physical qualification pending
Explicit input → admission
Typed / ordinary admitted voice
Not ordinary-command barge-in during TTS
32 waiting · priority + aging
Task ID · scope · shared family budget
Accepted or explicit rejection; no silent drop
Task Board
Actual coordinator rows + output
Cancel family / Stop all; outcome ≠ dispatch
1 interactive worker
Command / voice · fresh observation · native policy
One UI lease; serialized model calls as needed
2 non-UI slots · max 2 children / depth 1
Preparation → notes search + draft → separate outputs
Draft does NOT automatically incorporate notes
Guarded native effects + metadata WAL
Fresh native postconditions; Stop revokes authority
Recovery review only · no resume / replay / playback
Independent browser / Skills producers
Share UI/model leases and verified metadata WAL
NOT live Task Board coordinator worker rows
Future: unified all-lane worker rows
Not an implemented capability claim
Pending: physical qualification + safe phone cases
No fabricated speed, accuracy or success figures
Solid: implemented source boundaries. Dashed: future or qualification work. Not a screenshot, benchmark or live execution graph.
